common.footer: Free browser games — no accounts, no downloads.

footer.installHint: On mobile: browser menu → "Add to Home Screen". On desktop: install icon in the address bar.
footer.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? It replaces ALL current app data with the file contents.
footer.restored: Backup restored. The app will now reload.
footer.clearConfirm1: Clear all app data on this device? This cannot be undone.
footer.clearConfirm2: Really clear everything? Export a backup first if you need one.
footer.backupHint: Backup files may contain sensitive data — store them safely.
footer.tagline: Free browser games — no accounts, no downloads.
footer.bugCopy1: This app is built and maintained entirely by a 76-year-old independent developer living on a homestead. There is no corporate support desk, and I don't have the time or energy to answer individual support emails.
footer.bugCopy2: However, if you spot a bug or broken feature, let me know anyway! I regularly update and patch the app, so your bug reports go straight into the fix queue for the next update.
footer.copyInfoHint: Copies anonymous app details — no personal data. Pasting it into your bug report is optional, but it helps find the problem faster.
footer.suggestCopy1: This app is built and maintained entirely by a 76-year-old independent developer living on a homestead. I only build features that I personally find useful or enjoy crafting, so I can't promise to build every suggestion.
footer.suggestCopy2: However, if you have a brilliant idea for a lightweight, privacy-first game, share it anyway! If it tickles my curiosity, it just might show up in a future update.
footer.copyIdeaHint: Your idea is copied — paste it into a GitHub issue or anywhere handy.
